🤝 PMSOC INDUSTRY NIGHT S2 2026: 
The Art of Delivery - The People Behind the Project

Join PMSoc for our bi-annual Industry Night, bringing together students and industry professionals to explore the people, skills, and collaboration behind successful projects.

As PMSoc’s flagship event of the semester, this is your opportunity to connect with industry leaders, gain valuable insights into project delivery, and discover the people and teamwork that turn ambitious ideas into reality.

📍 Parkview, Doltone House - Darling Island, Pyrmont

⏰ 6:00 - 9:00 PM

🎟️ TICKET PRICING

🔥 Meet our INDUSTRY NIGHT PANELLISTS | Panel 2

We’re excited to introduce our second panel for PMSoc Industry Night 2026: The Art of Delivery - The People Behind the Project 🗣️

Bringing together decades of experience across education, portfolio planning, and major capital projects, our panellists will explore the complexities of project delivery, strategic planning, and stakeholder collaboration across large-scale infrastructure.

🏗️ David Wiles | Director, RP Infrastructure
📊 Alex Lysachenko | Portfolio Master Scheduler, Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry
🎓 David Browning | Associate Director, TSA Riley

From campus master planning and portfolio scheduling to delivering major education and social infrastructure, hear from experienced industry leaders on what it takes to turn complex projects into successful outcomes.
